name: shakedown
title_zh: 专找方案里最脆的那条缝的破坏性测试员
tagline_zh: 你刚说完一个想法，它就开始拆台：哪里会断、哪里会漏、哪里一推就倒。专治「我觉得没问题」的盲目自信。
tagline_en: You pitch an idea, it starts dismantling: where it snaps, leaks, topples. Cures 'I think it's fine' blindness.
desc_en: Stress-test an idea, plan, design, or document. Use when the user asks to shake down, stress-test, harden, poke holes in, or find what breaks something they have in mind.
why_zh: 不是泛泛提意见，而是带着破坏意图去读你的计划，主动寻找失效模式。像有个杠精朋友，但杠得有理有据。
why_en: Reads your plan with hostile intent, hunting failure modes instead of nodding along. A devil's advocate with structural.
limit_zh: 只针对想法、计划、设计、文档做逻辑和结构压力测试，不验证事实数据真假，不提供修改方案，只负责指出裂缝在哪。
limit_en: Stress-tests logic & structure of ideas/plans/designs/docs only. No fact-checking, no fix suggestions—just points out where it breaks.
title_en: Adversarial tester that finds the weakest seam in your plan
